descriptions.attackPower: Damage of each auto-attack, before crits and bonuses.
descriptions.attackSpeed: Seconds between auto-attacks. Lower is faster.
descriptions.critChance: Chance for a hit to be a critical hit. Spells crit only with the Spell Crit skill.
descriptions.critMulti: Damage multiplier of a critical hit.
descriptions.magicDamage: Added to every damaging spell's base damage.
descriptions.magicDamageMultiplier: Multiplies spell damage, after Magic Damage is added.
descriptions.maxMana: Mana spells cost to cast. Refills one point at a time up to the maximum.
descriptions.manaRegenRate: Seconds to regain one mana point. Lower is faster.
descriptions.spellCooldownReduction: Seconds taken off every spell's cooldown.
descriptions.increasedSpellDuration: Seconds added to every buff spell's duration.
descriptions.offlineProgressRate: Share of your normal kill rate you keep while away.
descriptions.shinyChance: Chance for an enemy to spawn as a shiny.
descriptions.maxTaskSlots: Exploration Guild tasks you can have at once.
descriptions.taskDoubleKillChance: Chance for a kill to count twice toward Guild tasks.
descriptions.weakness: Damage multiplier when you hit an enemy's elemental weakness with this element. Needs the Weaknesses skill.
descriptions.damageVs: Extra damage against enemies of this type, added on top of everything else.
